text: dsh-model-groups 是面向 DSH 网页端的模型选择器扩展：它在对话输入区域接入选择界面，把已有模型目录按平台和厂家展开分组，方便浏览 DeepSeek、Qwen、Doubao、GLM、Kimi、OpenAI、Claude、Gemini 等模型。选择模型时会调用现有目录服务，并可按模型元数据调整思考等级；当前选择和模型状态也会显示在界面中。分组只改变模型的展示方式，选择仍携带原平台和模型标识。适合希望在 DSH 中更直观浏览不同平台模型的用户。源码没有配置密钥或额外外部服务调用。

dsh-model-groups adds a DSH web model picker to the conversation input. It groups the existing model directory by provider and manufacturer. Users can select a model and, when model metadata supports it, adjust reasoning effort. Selection uses the existing directory service.
我想在 DSH 里按模型平台和厂家浏览可选模型。
I want to browse my configured models grouped by provider and maker.
dsh-model-groups 的功能「分组模型选择」：在对话输入区打开模型对话框，按平台及识别出的厂家分组展示现有模型目录。用户点击模型即可通过目录服务切换选择；有思考等级元数据的模型还可更改思考等级。

dsh-model-groups README · DSH Model Groups：Independent client plugin targeting DeepSeek Harness 0.1.1-rc.2. Uses the existing `modelDirectories` service and overrides only the `conversation.input.model` slot. Uninstalling restores the built-in model picker; `/model` remains owned by the built-in plugin.

dsh-model-groups README · DSH Model Groups：Platforms keep their original provider IDs; expandable manufacturer groups are presentation only. Unknown model IDs remain under Other/platform routing. Thinking controls come from the selected model's host metadata, not a hardcoded set of capabilities. No credentials are handled by this plugin.

The dialog uses the browser's native top layer to avoid clipping by theme containers. The original community skin and marketplace are not replaced.

dsh-model-groups README · DSH Model Groups：Install with the DSH profile plugin mechanism. Pin a compatible release and verify in an isolated profile before upgrading. This does not promise compatibility with arbitrary future DSH releases.

dsh-model-groups README · DSH Model Groups：After installing the package into the desired profile, add `dsh-model-groups` to that profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`, OR insert the entry from `cordis.patch.yml` into its profile patch. Do not do both. Do not disable the built-in model-selection plugin: it supplies the shared directory service and `/model` command.

dsh-model-groups README · DSH Model Groups：Validation: `npm test`. Integration checks on DSH 0.1.1-rc.2 covered manufacturer disclosure, exact provider/model routing, native top-layer placement and Escape dismissal. The plugin was also loaded from an installed macOS EAC profile and inspected through that live server in Chromium. Native WKWebView-specific regression and future DSH versions are not certified.

dsh-model-groups README · DSH Model Groups：Provenance: this is a separate client extension, not an official DSH plugin and not a replacement skin. It uses the open-source DSH slot and model-directory APIs. The existing EAC community marketplace remains unchanged.
